Class CharacterModel

java.lang.Object
model.entity.base.CharacterModel
Direct Known Subclasses:
Enemy, PlayerCharacter
public abstract class CharacterModel extends Object
Abstract class representing a character in the RPG game.

This class provides the core structure and behavior for all characters, including players and enemies. It manages the character's name, level, type, and stats (health, attack, defense, speed). It also handles combat mechanics such as attacking, taking damage, and calculating powerful attacks based on the game logic.

Concrete character classes (e.g. Warrior, Archer, Goblin) should extend this class and provide specific implementations if needed.

    • attack

      public int attack(CharacterModel target)
      Inflicts an attack against a target character. Damage calculation incorporates the "Powerful Attack" state and the speed ratio between the combatants.
      Parameters:
      target - the character being attacked.
      Returns:
      the actual damage the CharacterModel inflicts against another CharacterModel. It does it calling another method.
      See Also:
      • takeDamage(int)

    • takeDamage

      public int takeDamage(int damage)
      Applies damage to the character. If damage is blocked by defense, no health is lost and the next attack becomes powerful. Otherwise, real damage is applied and defense is reduced by 10%.
      Parameters:
      damage - the incoming damage value.
      Returns:
      the real damage taken (never negative).
      See Also:
      • attack(CharacterModel)

    • isAlive

      public boolean isAlive()

      Returns:
      true if this.health > 0, false otherwise

    • updateStatsFromLevel

      public void updateStatsFromLevel()
      Updates the character's stats according to the current level. Base stats are restored, then modified using the multipliers stored in Difficulty.
